subject.title: feat(browser): My Browser node-anchored turn routing (stacks on #93411)

question: Should this PR be salvaged as a side-panel/node-routed delta on top of the merged Chrome extension relay, or should the branch be closed as superseded by the current main relay direction?
rationale: Current main now has a maintainer-owned Chrome extension relay with a different package location and driver contract, while this PR may still contain unique side-panel/node-routing ideas; only maintainers can decide whether that product surface belongs in core and how it should attach to the canonical extension.

options.title: Rebase And Salvage Side Panel
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main and keep only the unique side-panel/node-routing pieces that extend the canonical browser plugin extension.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers decide the merged relay plus follow-up issues should own all remaining browser-extension work.

options.title: Accept A Separate Extension
options.body: Allow a second browser-copilot extension package only if maintainers intentionally want two shipped Chrome extension surfaces and own the security/compatibility cost.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Salvage Side Panel
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main and keep only the unique side-panel/node-routing pieces that extend the canonical browser plugin extension.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current-main relay direction through the merged canonical Chrome extension PR, so this product-direction choice should align with that implementation.
